title: Core Breaker
brief: Slide your auto-firing ship under a hexagon core that drops orbs and escalates at half health; empty its health bar to win, lose all lives to lose.

title: Shield Siege
brief: Shoot three waves of raiders while two damageable shields soak up their shots; clear 24 raiders to win, lose all lives to lose.

title: Twin Guardians
brief: Collect crystals while two patrolling guardians hunt you; four crystals charge a zap that hurts the core, three zaps win, touching a guardian ends the run.

title: Phase Tower
brief: Shoot a tower boss whose attack pattern changes at 20 and 10 health; empty its bar to win, lose all lives to lose.

title: Dodge Arena
brief: No weapons: dodge falling bolts, a sentry and a sweeping patrol for 40 seconds while the waves speed up; survive to win.

title: Minion Swarm
brief: Tap the minions and tougher brutes a warlord keeps sending toward your keep; reach 30 points to win, lose all lives to lose.

title: Shield Bearer
brief: Destroy two weak-point nodes to break the boss shield, then shoot the exposed boss eight times while dodging fireballs.

title: Harbor Cannon
brief: Move a cannon along the dock and tap FIRE to sink skiffs and a flagship in waves; sink 20 to win, lose all lives to lose.

title: Boss Gauntlet
brief: Two levels, two bosses: beat a slime, then an enraging golem, with lives carried across; lose all lives to lose.

title: Ricochet Boss
brief: Bounce a ball off your paddle into a moving ring boss while blocking its darts; ten hits win, letting the ball or darts drain your lives loses.

title: Hive Defender
brief: Gather nectar and shoot the queen bee while patrol bees and homing stings hunt you; 25 honey wins, losing all lives loses.
